About Us:

Tradezone is one of Australia’s fastest-growing electrical wholesalers. Since launching in 2015, we’ve grown to operate six state-of-the-art distribution centres nationwide, supplying electrical, solar, HVAC, data and safety products to trade professionals across Australia - with further expansion on the horizon.

As part of the Kingston Group, a privately owned, family-run Australian business with more than 40 years of wholesale and distribution experience, Tradezone combines the scale and capability of a national operation with the culture and values of a close-knit team.

Technology and innovation are at the heart of what we do. From our real-time online platform and live-stock visibility, to our dedicated national delivery fleet with live tracking, we’re continually investing in smarter, more efficient ways to serve our customers and support our continued growth.

About the Role:

Technology drives our business forward, and we’re proud to have our own creative and practical in-house IT and technology teams. We’re seeking a Senior Software Engineer who wants to make a real impact.

You’ll help design, build and evolve the technology behind our growing national operations, from our real-time online platform and live stock visibility to the systems supporting our distribution centers, offices and customer experience.

If you enjoy solving meaningful problems and seeing the real-world impact of your work, we’d like to hear from you.

Your Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain scalable applications, APIs and integrations.

  • Contribute to software architecture, technical decisions and engineering best practices.

  • Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code.

  • AutoStore / WMS & Robotics Integrations — integrating warehouse management systems with AutoStore or other robotic automation platforms to support inventory, order fulfilment and warehouse operations.

  • Optimise databases, troubleshoot complex issues and improve system performance.

  • Deploy and support production applications, including ongoing maintenance and upgrades.

  • Work with teams across the business to turn operational requirements into practical solutions.

What You’ll Bring

Good communication skills and the ability to take direction and respond positively to this.

Substantial hands-on experience building and maintaining production systems, with strong skills in:

  • Typescript, JavaScript, React, Node.js and Next.js.

  • Python & Flask - Including maintaining and improving legacy applications

  • backend development, APIs, integrations, automation and database access.

  • PostgreSQL and MySQL, with strong understanding of data integrity and migrations.

  • Docker & Dokploy - containerisation, Docker Compose, networking, persistent storage, deployment and application management.

  • APIs, background workers, queues, retries and integration troubleshooting.

  • Testing, debugging and safe deployment of production changes.

  • Ability to understand business workflows and communicate with users.

  • Linux / Debian - deploying, supporting and troubleshooting applications in Debian-based production environments.

  • Nginx & uWSGI - reverse proxying, TLS and Python application serving where required.

  • ElectricSQL / Electric - synchronising PostgreSQL data with client applications.

  • Experience with Warehouse, inventory, logistics or ERP systems; Linux and Docker; barcode scanners and offline-capable applications; AI integrations is highly regarded

You take ownership of your work, communicate clearly and bring a proactive, practical approach to solving problems. You’re comfortable collaborating with technical colleagues and stakeholders across the business.

Why Tradezone?

Join a fast-growing Australian business where technology isn’t just part of what we do – it drives us forward.

With expansive B2B and B2C platforms, complex engineering challenges and ambitious growth plans, you’ll have the opportunity to shape technical solutions, influence how we build and scale, and turn big ideas into real-world impact.

Work alongside smart, creative people who challenge convention, solve meaningful problems and are always looking for better ways to do things.

Big ideas. Smart tech. Real impact. If you’re ready to take ownership, push boundaries and help shape what’s next at Tradezone, we’d love to hear from you.

The Southport School (TSS) is one of Queensland’s oldest schools: an Anglican day and boarding school for boys on the Gold Coast’s beautiful Nerang River. We blend tradition with innovation, and our community is built on teamwork, scholarship and service.

We are looking for a capable, service-minded IT Support Officer to join our expanding Corporate IT Team commencing 4 January 2027 for training ahead of our school term commencing. Help keep our students, boarders and staff connected and confident with technology. 

About the role

Reporting to the Chief Information Officer, you will be joining the IT Support Team as one of our first points of contact for technology support across our two campuses, troubleshooting day-to-day issues, escalating where needed and following up to make sure problems are resolved. You will:

  • Provide prompt, friendly first-level support to students, staff and boarding residents, including connecting personal devices to the school network and responding quickly to classroom technology emergencies
  • Assist with provisioning, imaging and deploying student and staff devices, and with onboarding, account creation and network logins
  • Diagnose and repair end-user hardware, or manage warranty and RMA processes with external vendors
  • Maintain the asset register, device history records and software licence records
  • Install, set up, test and maintain audiovisual equipment, supporting weekly events and key school events, including some outside regular hours

About You

Relevant experience or broad knowledge in related technical fields, including troubleshooting Windows, macOS and Linux, Active Directory or Azure AD, networking fundamentals, and Microsoft 365 support. A calm, patient communicator who can turn technical jargon into simple steps and reassure users under pressure.

  • Self-motivated, able to work unsupervised, and comfortable in a fast-paced, changing environment
  • A Bachelor’s degree or industry certifications (desirable)
  • A current driver’s licence and vehicle for travel between campuses (located across the road from each other in Southport)
  • A current Paid Blue Card (Working with Children Check) obtained prior to commencement  and recent Criminal History Check Certificate.

What we offer

  • Permanent, full-time term-time employment in a supportive, close-knit school community
  • Spend school holidays with your family and friends
  • Onsite parking
  • Access to our gym and pool
  • Discounts at The Thirty Two Dental Studio

Child safety

TSS is an Anglican child safe organisation committed to promoting the safety, wellbeing and best interests of children. All appointments are subject to a satisfactory Paid Blue Card and criminal history check, and successful applicants will be required to understand and uphold our child safety obligations.

How to apply

Apply online via the TSS careers page. Applications should include a cover letter addressed to the Chief Information Officer and resume.

Applications close at 8.00am on Monday 23 November 2026.

We support our clients across Microsoft 365, cloud services, cybersecurity, networking, backup, endpoint management and day-to-day IT support.

As Cursa continues to grow, we're looking for an enthusiastic Level 1 IT Support Engineer to join our technical team.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys technology, problem solving and helping people. You'll be responsible for providing frontline technical support to our clients while working alongside experienced engineers who can assist with more complex issues.

  • Provide friendly and professional Level 1 technical support

  • Troubleshoot Windows desktops, laptops and common business applications

  • Support Microsoft 365 applications including Outlook, Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint

  • Assist with Microsoft 365 user accounts, passwords, groups and permissions

  • Assist with new user onboarding and employee offboarding

  • Troubleshoot printers, scanners and other business peripherals

  • Assist with basic internet, Wi-Fi and network connectivity issues

  • Assist with email and Outlook troubleshooting

About you

We're looking for someone who enjoys technology but also understands that great IT support is about people as much as computers.

Ideally, you'll have:

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365

  • Exposure to a wide variety of technologies and client environments

  • Hands-on experience across Microsoft 365, cloud, networking, security and infrastructure

Position Title: Photocopier & POS Technician
Location: Nerang, QLD

This role requires a customer-focused approach, strong technical skills, and the ability to work independently while delivering a high standard of service and support to our valued clients.

  • Strong interpersonal skills and a commitment to exceptional customer service.

  • Ability to work independently and manage time effectively.

 Key Attributes

  • Professional and reliable with a positive attitude.

  • Flexible and adaptable to changing work requirements.

  • Willingness to learn and stay updated with new technology.

  • Commitment to workplace safety and compliance procedures.

About Comtech Business Equipment

Comtech Business Equipment is Australian owned and operated company based in Brisbane, Darling Downs, Gold Coast & Northern Rivers, Melbourne, and Sydney, providing business printing solutions and technical support throughout Australia. We pride ourselves on outstanding customer service and building long-term relationships with our clients.

About us

Born and bred on the Gold Coast, our company designs and develops unique lifestyle apparel, headwear, sunglasses and accessories for quality retailers around the world. Our market leading brands are designed and developed by our talented in-house team with an eye for quality, attention to detail and a passion for the outdoor lifestyle.

From humble beginnings, we have experienced continuous growth over the last 25 years. We are now stocked in retailers all over Australia, Japan, New Zealand, the Caribbean, Canada and the USA. We have established an excellent reputation for innovative and quality products that our retailers and consumers love equally.


Role Summary

The Head of IT & Business Systems is responsible for leading the growth and implementation of the company’s technology strategy and enhancing business systems to support growth, efficiency, and innovation. This role oversees the design, implementation, security, and optimisation of all IT infrastructure and business applications, ensuring systems are reliable, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

The role partners with Department Heads to identify and implement technology solutions that improve processes, drive operational efficiencies, and support cross-departmental collaboration. It is accountable for application development, system integrations, data management, and continuous improvement of IT tools, ensuring that technology enables informed decision-making and supports both strategic and operational goals. As a forward-thinking leader, you will be highly proficient in using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to streamline and enhance business systems, championing the adoption of AI technologies across the organisation to uncover opportunities for automation, smarter decision-making, and structural efficiency.

Project management is a key aspect of this role, including planning, executing, and delivering technology initiatives on time and within budget. The Head of IT & Business Systems also manages vendor relationships, IT budgets, and ensures compliance with internal standards and best practices.


Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy

  • Ensure IT initiatives support overall company strategy and drive growth.

  • Drive innovation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI, to maintain competitive advantage.

  • Develop and maintain the IT roadmap.

  • Oversee planning and delivery of IT projects, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.

AI, Automation & Innovation

  • Leverage deep proficiency in AI to evaluate, pilot, and embed intelligent tools that streamline workflows and enhance existing business systems.

  • Identify operational bottlenecks and deploy AI-driven automation (e.g., machine learning, predictive analytics, generative AI) to eliminate manual processes.

  • Establish frameworks and best practices for the ethical, secure, and effective use of AI tools across the organization.

Business Systems & Applications

  • Lead the development, improvement, and integration of business systems and applications (ERP, CRM, POS, BI, PLM, etc.).

  • Ensure applications are integrated seamlessly across departments, improving workflow and data accuracy with a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Evaluate and implement new technology solutions to enhance business processes and support decision-making.

  • Oversee data warehouse strategy, analytics tools, and system enhancements.

  • Manage projects related to system upgrades, integrations, and new application implementations.

IT Operations

  • Enhance efficiency, reliability, and scalability of infrastructure and business systems.

  • Maintain IT uptime and infrastructure reliability through day-to-day monitoring and maintenance.

  • Manage internal and external IT vendors to maintain service levels and cost efficiency.

  • Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans.

  • Provide onboarding and offboarding functionality across IT systems and security.

  • Work closely with service providers to ensure hardware is fit for purpose and suitable for a global business structure.

Cross-Department Collaboration & Efficiency

  • Partner with Department Heads to identify and implement opportunities to drive operational efficiencies through technology.

  • Translate business requirements into IT solutions, managing projects, timelines, and budgets.

  • Ensure applications are fully utilized and understood by teams to maximize functionality.

  • Provide technology guidance and training to staff to ensure adoption of systems and processes.

Governance & Security

  • Establish IT policies, standards, and governance frameworks.

  • Manage IT budgets and ensure cost-effective technology investments.

  • With third-party assistance, oversee cybersecurity initiatives, including risk assessments, user governance, IT policies, and incident response.


About You:

The ideal candidate will possess a strong analytical mindset, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of IT strategy, business systems, infrastructure management, and technology-driven process improvement. Of course, your leadership extends to coaching and developing teams and nurturing high-performance cultures. You will possess a passion for leadership and an innate drive for success.


Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Information Systems, or a related field; MBA or relevant post-grad preferred.

  • Proven track record in a senior IT leadership role (e.g., Head of IT, IT Director, or Business Systems Manager), ideally within a scaling or global business structure.

  • Strong hands-on experience managing and integrating enterprise business systems such as ERP, CRM, POS, BI, and PLM.

  • Demonstrated experience successfully auditing, piloting, and deploying AI solutions or machine learning models to optimise business operations.

  • Deep practical knowledge of modern AI tools, predictive analytics, generative AI, and robotic process automation (RPA) to drive business efficiency.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing, data governance, and business intelligence tools to enable data-driven decision-making.

  • Proven success leading complex, cross-departmental technology projects on time and within budget using structured methodologies.

  • Firm grasp of cybersecurity principles, risk assessments, and compliance frameworks, including the specific data privacy implications of utilizing AI.

  • Strong commercial acumen with experience negotiating vendor SLAs and managing comprehensive IT budgets.

  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex AI and IT concepts into actionable business strategies for non-technical Department Heads.


For You:

We offer a highly competitive salary.

As a valued member of our team, you'll play a pivotal role in our company's success and you will be part of a collaborative and passionate team.

We're a genuine, rapidly growing, business in a vibrant Burleigh Heads location with bright, clean, sunny offices. We are deeply invested in our staff's well-being, and we actively support environmental initiatives.

We prioritise work-life balance and prioritise the personal well-being of our employees. Moreover, we're committed to fostering growth and development opportunities, both personally and professionally, and we have a culture of nurturing talent from within. If you possess the skills and experience to drive strategic initiatives and optimise our commercial performance, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

Our great company culture is rooted in our core values.

📞 About the role

Aged Care Decisions runs contact centre teams across Australia and offshore, all on 3CX. We’re looking for a hands-on 3CX and telephony specialist to own our voice and SMS environment: keep it running smoothly, look after day-to-day changes and support, and make sure it’s well documented.

This is a remote, part-time contract of around three months:

  • Month 1: one day a week. Handover, getting to know our setup, and picking up open support items.

  • After that: around four to eight hours a week for routine support, with extra hours agreed as needed.

  • Major outages: we’d like to agree a coverage window and response time with you for critical failures (e.g. queues down, inbound calls failing). Tell us what you can offer.


🛠️ What you’ll do

  • Administer and troubleshoot 3CX v20: users, extensions, queues, ring groups, IVRs, business hours, voicemail and inbound/outbound call routing

  • Manage SIP trunks, phone numbers, caller ID, number allocation, porting and routing changes; maintain an accurate number and service inventory

  • Support inbound, outbound and two-way SMS; trace delivery failures across carriers, messaging providers and our business systems

  • Diagnose call quality, dropped calls, one-way audio, registration and connectivity issues using call records, logs, packet captures and network diagnostics

  • Own supplier escalations through to verified resolution

  • Maintain our Linux-based 3CX environment on AWS: monitoring, backups, security and controlled updates

  • Own the 3CX and carrier side of our integrations (call recording, Microsoft Teams presence, CRM): configure and test APIs and webhooks, troubleshoot issues and write small telephony scripts where needed. Our developers own application code changes; you’ll help define what’s needed and test the full flow with them

  • Review carrier invoices, call classifications and usage charges; investigate discrepancies with suppliers and finance

  • Document routing, configuration and support procedures, with tested changes and rollback plans


✅ What you’ll bring

  • Proven hands-on 3CX administration and troubleshooting, including v20 and contact centre queue and routing configurations

  • Strong SIP/VoIP and networking skills: DNS, firewalls, NAT and audio troubleshooting; comfortable reading logs and packet captures

  • Experience with Australian carriers, number porting, and SMS delivery and routing across multiple suppliers

  • Practical Linux and AWS skills; hands-on with REST APIs, webhooks and light scripting for communications integrations

  • Clear communication, reliable follow-through and concise documentation; able to work independently and remotely


🏢 Company Profile

Aged Care Decisions is passionate about helping people in need, empowering them in their health care experiences. Our services encompass placement care, service provider matching, cutting-edge technology solutions, and a comprehensive consumer review website. We’ve since launched Care Decisions, bringing the same model to Australians navigating the NDIS.

Find out more about our company: https://agedcaredecisions.com.au/about/

Read what clients and families say about us: https://g.page/r/CTbfWRSCdvPpEBA

Our contact centre teams help families find care every day, so when the phones work, people get help faster.

✉️ To apply


Send your CV and a short note covering:

  1. The largest 3CX environment you’ve managed (users, queues, sites)

  2. A voice or SMS problem you traced across multiple suppliers, and how you fixed it

  3. What outage cover you could offer (hours and response time)

Looking for an IT role where you can actually build your skills, work with great technology and have some freedom in how you get the job done?

Neteffects is looking for an enthusiastic Support Engineer to join our growing team.

Based on the Gold Coast, Neteffects has been providing IT consulting, managed services and technology support to organisations in Australia and around the world for more than 26 years.

With continued growth and expansion, we're looking for another great person to join our team.

This is a full-time position, preferably based on the Gold Coast, with the opportunity to work across a diverse range of customer environments, technologies and projects.

The Role

As a Support Engineer, you'll be part of the team responsible for supporting and managing our customers' technology environments.

This isn't a role where we expect you to know everything from day one. Training and support will be provided, with the aim of developing your skills and progressively involving you in more complex support, implementation projects and the ongoing management of customer networks.

Depending on your experience, your day could include:

  • Troubleshooting Windows desktop and application issues

  • Supporting Microsoft 365, Teams, SharePoint and OneDrive

  • Managing user accounts, permissions, MFA and Microsoft Entra ID

  • Supporting Windows Server and Active Directory environments

  • Troubleshooting networks, switches, Wi-Fi, firewalls and VPNs

  • Assisting with Microsoft Azure and cloud environments

  • Supporting Microsoft Intune and managed endpoints

  • Monitoring and maintaining customer systems

  • Managing patching, software deployment and endpoint security

  • Troubleshooting backup and recovery issues

  • Working with virtualised server environments

  • Using remote monitoring, management and ticketing platforms

  • Providing remote and onsite customer support

  • Assisting senior engineers with infrastructure, cloud and security projects

  • Maintaining accurate technical documentation

Our engineers work across desktop, Microsoft 365, device, application, network and infrastructure troubleshooting, with experienced senior engineers available for escalation of more complex cloud, identity, security and infrastructure issues.

Technologies You'll Work With

Neteffects works across a wide range of technologies and vendors, including:

  • Microsoft 365

  • Microsoft Azure

  • Microsoft Entra ID

  • Microsoft Intune

  • Windows Server

  • Cisco

  • Cisco Meraki

  • AWS

  • Veeam

  • ConnectWise

  • Lenovo

  • Endpoint and cybersecurity technologies

  • Hyper-V and VMware

  • Networking, switching, firewalls and wireless infrastructure

The breadth of the role is significant. Current Neteffects work includes technologies and projects involving Intune, Purview, Conditional Access, Exchange Online, certificate services, domain controllers, virtual machines, switching and firewall infrastructure.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in people who are genuinely enthusiastic about technology and want to continue developing their skills.

You don't need to tick every box.

Experience in any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Microsoft 365 or Microsoft environments

  • Windows desktops and servers

  • Active Directory and Entra ID

  • Cisco or Meraki networking

  • Azure or AWS

  • Firewalls, switching, Wi-Fi and VPNs

  • Veeam or other backup platforms

  • RMM and ticketing platforms

  • PowerShell

  • MSP or IT service provider environments

A relevant degree, Microsoft certification or Cisco certification would be advantageous, but practical skills, attitude and your ability to learn are equally important.

More Than Technical Skills

We're looking for someone who:

  • Enjoys solving problems

jobs.job_description:
You know manufacturing.

Not just that factories are full of expensive machinery, production schedules rarely go exactly to plan, and the words "the system is down" can make an Operations Manager's blood pressure rise faster than a Friday afternoon production deadline.

You understand how manufacturing businesses actually operate, how business owners and operations leaders think, how technology decisions get made, and why reliability matters more than the cheapest quote.

Maybe you've sold manufacturing technology. Maybe you've worked in manufacturing IT. Maybe you've helped manufacturers modernise production systems, cybersecurity, ERP platforms, infrastructure or cloud environments.

Whatever your path, you know that manufacturing businesses don't buy technology for technology's sake. They buy outcomes.

First Focus is looking for a Manufacturing Technology Consultant to help Australian manufacturers confidently navigate AI, cybersecurity, managed IT and cloud transformation.

We are Australia's leading managed AI and IT services provider, and our marketing engine delivers a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities from businesses already looking to improve how they work.

This is an individual contributor role. It isn't a graduate sales position, and it isn't a lead generation role. You'll need to arrive with strong commercial instincts, excellent discovery skills, genuine depth of manufacturing industry knowledge and the ability to build credibility quickly with business owners, Managing Directors, Operations Managers and manufacturing leaders.


What You'll Be Doing

You'll work with small and mid-sized manufacturing businesses, typically between 20 and 250 users, who are reviewing their technology strategy, cybersecurity, AI roadmap or existing IT partner.

AI is rapidly changing manufacturing.

Business owners and operations leaders want to know how Microsoft Copilot, secure AI assistants and automation can improve production planning, inventory management, reporting, supply chain visibility and productivity without compromising operational reliability, data security or business continuity.

You'll help manufacturers move beyond AI curiosity into practical, secure and commercially sensible adoption.

You'll lead the commercial conversation from qualification through to proposal and close. That means understanding how the business operates, where technology is creating friction, how decisions are made, who needs to be involved and what success looks like.

You'll work closely with technical specialists, solution architects and delivery teams, but you'll own the client relationship and sales process. You'll be expected to quickly develop a strong understanding of First Focus's AI, cybersecurity, cloud and managed services offerings, confidently lead technical and commercial conversations, and translate these services into outcomes that resonate with business owners, operations leaders and manufacturing executives. You'll be expected to quickly master the key technical talking points and confidently lead client conversations independently, bringing in technical specialists for genuinely complex requirements rather than routine discussions.

You'll write clear, commercially credible proposals that explain the business case for change, while ensuring smooth handovers into implementation because a successful sale doesn't end with a signature.

And in manufacturing, a successful implementation means a lot more than everyone being able to log into their laptops on Monday morning.


About You

You understand that selling into manufacturing businesses is different.

Trust is earned. Reliability matters. Downtime matters. Relationships matter.

You know how to have commercial conversations with professionals who expect you to understand their business before talking about yours.

You understand that when production stops, the consequences aren't just technical. They can mean missed deadlines, lost revenue, disrupted supply chains and some fairly unhappy customers.

You're also naturally curious about AI and already using it to improve the way you work, whether that's research, writing, preparation, productivity or client engagement.

You'll probably be a great fit if you have:

  • At least five years' experience in consultative B2B sales, solution consulting or technology consulting, with sustained exposure to the manufacturing industry.

  • Demonstrated depth of experience selling into manufacturing businesses or working directly within manufacturing, industrial or production environments. You'll understand manufacturing workflows, operational systems and decision-making processes, and be able to explain technology decisions you've personally influenced and the outcomes delivered.

  • Experience with managed services, manufacturing technology, cybersecurity, cloud, AI, ERP systems, infrastructure or operational technology.

  • Confidence engaging with Managing Directors, Business Owners, CEOs, CFOs, COOs, Operations Managers, Production Managers and IT decision-makers.

  • Strong discovery skills and the discipline to qualify opportunities properly.

  • Excellent written communication and proposal development skills.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to quickly become confident discussing AI, cybersecurity, cloud and managed services independently, including the key capabilities, risks and business outcomes, without routinely relying on technical specialists to lead client conversations.

  • High commercial standards and the expectation that your remuneration reflects the value you create.

Experience with manufacturing technologies, manufacturing execution and production management platforms would be highly regarded, but isn't essential.

An understanding of operational technology (OT), industrial networks, production environments or the challenges of connecting factory-floor systems with business IT would also be valuable.

You don't need to know how to repair a CNC machine. But understanding why an unexpected production outage is a bigger problem than someone's Outlook calendar refusing to synchronise would certainly help.

This role probably isn't the right fit if your experience has been primarily lead generation, transactional product sales or heavily supported enterprise sales where large bid teams carry most of the commercial process.

We're specifically looking for someone who understands the manufacturing industry, not simply a generalist technology consultant looking for a new market to sell into.


What Great Looks Like

Within six months you'll be confidently leading strategic and technical conversations with business owners, Managing Directors and manufacturing leaders, independently communicating the value of First Focus's services, converting qualified opportunities into long-term managed services clients and becoming a trusted advisor to manufacturers navigating AI and technology change.

You'll build credibility because you understand the commercial realities of manufacturing.

You'll earn trust internally because you qualify thoroughly, sell accurately and hand over opportunities that delivery teams genuinely enjoy implementing.

Most importantly, you'll help Australian manufacturers embrace AI safely, improve cybersecurity, modernise infrastructure, reduce operational risk and create better experiences for their employees and customers.

You'll understand that technology should support production, not become another reason production stops.


Why First Focus

Manufacturing businesses don't need another IT supplier.

They need a technology partner who understands operational reliability, cyber risk, business continuity and how manufacturing businesses actually work.

First Focus is Australia's leading managed AI and IT services provider, with more than 350 specialists across Australia, New Zealand and the Philippines.

We're helping Australian businesses use AI in practical, secure and commercially valuable ways. Behind every conversation you'll have is deep technical capability across managed AI, managed IT, cybersecurity, cloud, Microsoft technologies, modern workplace and business technology.

You'll have genuine delivery capability behind you, a trusted brand in the market and a marketing engine generating qualified demand.

You won't spend your days cold calling from a spreadsheet.

You'll spend them helping manufacturers that already know they need to modernise, making smart technology decisions that improve productivity, reduce risk, strengthen business continuity and create lasting client relationships.

Our First Focus values include Be the Solution, which fits this role particularly well. We believe in taking ownership, solving problems and following through, rather than selling technology and leaving someone else to deal with the consequences.

Because when a manufacturer's systems stop working, "have you tried turning it off and on again?" isn't always the commercially sensible answer.

Learn more about First Focus and our values at https://www.firstfocus.com.au/about-us/.


What You'll Get

  • A competitive base salary between $150,000–$200,000 base excluding superannuation, plus up to $100k OTE

  • A strong pipeline of qualified opportunities, supported by an established marketing engine.

  • Flexible working arrangements that support genuine work-life balance.

  • Free access to Uprise, including 1:1 coaching with qualified psychologists or counsellors.

  • Never Stop Growing: 10 paid study days per year, paid exam fees and pay rises for certifications (conditions apply).

  • Weekly internal training sessions and access to our learning library.

  • Our FastTrack mentoring program to support your development.

  • Our MAD (Making a Difference) Council, supporting equality, charity and environmental initiatives.

  • The option of a Tesla company car (conditions apply).

  • Regular social events and a genuinely supportive team culture.


Ready to Make an Impact?

If you understand manufacturing, know how to build trusted commercial relationships and want to help Australian businesses make smarter technology decisions, we'd love to hear from you.

Bring your industry expertise, your commercial instincts and your curiosity.

We'll bring the technical expertise, qualified opportunities and a team that knows how to deliver.
